name: Stock Analysis
description: A-share multi-dimensional stock analysis with technical, fundamental, sentiment and AI-assisted research.
author: easykai
tagline:
A股多维研判
数据辅助决策

settings_schema.title: Stock Analysis Settings
settings_schema.description: Configure the stock analysis plugin data source and cache directory.

tushare_token.title: Tushare Token
tushare_token.description: Your own Tushare token from tushare.pro (optional). Empty = auto fallback to free sources (akshare/sina).

fmp_api_key.title: FMP API Key
fmp_api_key.description: Financial Modeling Prep API key for US stock fundamentals, consensus estimates and price targets.

polygon_api_key.title: Polygon API Key
polygon_api_key.description: Polygon.io API key for US stock K-line, quotes and news.

data_provider.title: Data Provider
data_provider.description: Preferred market data source override (empty = follow default route order).

data_cache_dir.title: Data Cache Directory
data_cache_dir.description: Directory for cached market data. Reserved for future file-based caching.

auto_deep_research_on_batch.title: Auto Deep Research After Batch
auto_deep_research_on_batch.description: After the daily batch analysis finishes, automatically enqueue LLM deep research for high-confidence symbols. Disabled by default.

index_selection.title: Index Selection
index_selection.description: Indices shown on the market overview page. Empty = fall back to the three major A-share indices (SSE, SZSE Component, ChiNext).
